text: OWNER DECISION — tension has no dependence on population size, so the engine never learns it has enough cells. Everything with a mechanical cause is now fixed (661a083: division no longer inflates the child; tension rise across 3->32 cells is 1.2x, was 12x; splits 984 -> 46). What remains is definitional: with the runaway gone the population still saturates — quantile 0.75 and below reach the 32 ceiling, 0.80 and above stay at 2, a cliff with no band. The two candidate fixes both change what tension MEANS: (a) division relieves per-cell load, (b) the split trigger normalises by population size. Neither is an audit's call. Measured in docs/mitosis-calibration.md.
